mutants.query: SELECT c.id AS customer_id,c.name,COUNT(*) AS paid_orders FROM customers c LEFT JOIN orders o ON o.customer_id=c.id AND o.status='paid' GROUP BY c.id,c.name
SELECT c.id AS customer_id,c.name,COUNT(o.id) AS paid_orders FROM customers c LEFT JOIN orders o ON o.customer_id=c.id GROUP BY c.id,c.name
SELECT c.id AS customer_id,c.name,COUNT(DISTINCT o.status) AS paid_orders FROM customers c LEFT JOIN orders o ON o.customer_id=c.id AND o.status='paid' GROUP BY c.id,c.name
SELECT o.customer_id,SUM(DISTINCT o.total_cents) AS revenue_cents FROM orders o LEFT JOIN items i ON i.order_id=o.id WHERE o.status='paid' GROUP BY o.customer_id
SELECT o.customer_id,SUM(o.total_cents) AS revenue_cents FROM orders o LEFT JOIN items i ON i.order_id=o.id WHERE o.status='paid' GROUP BY o.customer_id
SELECT customer_id,SUM(total_cents) AS revenue_cents FROM orders GROUP BY customer_id
SELECT s.id AS subscriber_id,s.email FROM subscribers s WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM suppressions x WHERE x.subscriber_id=s.id)
SELECT s.id AS subscriber_id,s.email FROM subscribers s WHERE s.active=1
SELECT s.id AS subscriber_id,s.email FROM subscribers s WHERE s.active=1 AND s.id NOT IN (SELECT subscriber_id FROM suppressions WHERE subscriber_id IS NOT NULL) AND s.id>0
